WITH player_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    a.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as total
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) as avg_total
  FROM player_totals
)
SELECT 
  SUM(pt.total) as sum_of_totals,
  AVG(pt.total - oa.avg_total) as avg_excess
FROM player_totals pt
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE pt.total > oa.avg_total;
